questions.title: 第 01 题
tags: 热学/热力学第一定律/能量守恒/热平衡温度计算
questions.content:
A.1 用布莱克原理，平衡温度可由下式得到：

$$m_w c_{vw}(T_e - T_w) + m_m c_{vm}(T_e - T_m) = 0$$

因此

$$T_e = \frac{m_w c_{vw} T_w + m_m c_{vm} T_m}{m_w c_{vw} + m_m c_{vm}}$$
questions.answer: $$T_e = \frac{m_w c_{vw} T_w + m_m c_{vm} T_m}{m_w c_{vw} + m_m c_{vm}}$$

questions.title: 第 03 题
tags: 力学/量纲分析/量纲齐次性/量纲分析法
questions.content:
A.3 The relative velocity $u_{rel}$ can be expressed as $u_{rel} = \kappa \dot{p}^{\alpha} V^{\beta} m^{\gamma}$ where $\kappa$ is a dimensionless constant. Using dimensional analysis, one can obtain that

$$LT^{-1} = M^{\alpha+\gamma} L^{-\alpha+3\beta} T^{-2\alpha}$$

$$\alpha + \gamma = 0$$

$$-\alpha + 3\beta = 1$$

$$-2\alpha = -1$$

Therefore $u_{rel} = \kappa\, p^{1/2} V^{1/2} m^{-1/2}$

B.4

By using Snell's law and defining $p = \sin \theta / \nu$ and $u = 1 / \nu$, we obtain $p \equiv u(0)\sin\theta_{0} = u(z)\sin\theta$; $\sin \theta = \frac{p}{u(z)}$

where $u(z) = 1/v(z)$ and $\theta_0$ is the initial angle of the seismic wave direction.

$$\frac{dz}{ds} = \cos \theta = \sqrt{1 - \left( \frac{p}{u(z)} \right)^2}$$

$$\frac{dx}{ds} = \sin \theta = \frac{p}{u(z)}; \quad \frac{dx}{dz} = \frac{dx}{ds} \frac{ds}{dz} = \frac{p}{u} \frac{u}{\left( u^{2} - p^{2} \right)^{1/2}} = p / \left( u^{2} - p^{2} \right)^{1/2}$$

$$x = \int_{z_{1}}^{z_{2}} \frac{p}{\left( u^{2} - p^{2} \right)^{1/2}} \, dz$$

![](data/images/2017-ipho-3b837d60/2017-IPhO-理论-第二题-答案-3.jpg)

Illustration for the direction of wave. The distance $X$ is equal to twice the distance from epicenter to the turning point. The turning point is the point when $\theta = 90^\circ$. Thus

$$p = u(z_t) = \frac{1}{\nu_0 + a z_t}; \quad z_t = \frac{1 - p \nu_0}{a p}$$

$$X = 2 \int_{0}^{z_{i}} \frac{p(v_{0} + az)}{(1 - p^{2}(v_{0} + az)^{2})^{1/2}} dz = \frac{2}{ap} \left( \sqrt{1 - p^{2}(v_{0} + az)^{2}} - \sqrt{1 - p^{2}v_{0}^{2}} \right)$$

力学/振动/波动方程/波速推导
questions.content:
C.2 Considering a shallow ocean wave in Fig. 5, the whole water (from the surface until the ocean floor) can be considered to be moving due to the wave motion. The potential energy is equal to the kinetic energy.

$$\frac{1}{4}\rho\lambda h^2 L g = \frac{1}{4}\rho d L\lambda U^2$$

Where $x = \lambda/2$ and $U$ is the horizontal speed of the water component. The water component that was in the upper part $hL\frac{\lambda}{2}$ should be equal to the one that moves horizontally for a half of period of time $\tau/2$, i.e.

$$hL\lambda/2 = dLU\tau/2$$

Thus we have $U = \frac{h\lambda}{\tau d}$. Accordingly, $\tau = \frac{\lambda}{\sqrt{gd}}$. Thus $v = \frac{\lambda}{\tau} = \sqrt{gd}$.

questions.content: C.3 利用波的能量密度与其振幅平方成正比的论点 $E = k A^{2}$，其中 $A$ 为振幅，$k$ 为比例常数。由于能量通量守恒，则对波流过的面积 $a$ 有 $E v a = E_{0} v_{0} a$。于是 $k A^{2}\sqrt{gd} = k A_{0}^{2}\sqrt{gd_{0}}$，得 $A = A_{0}\left(\frac{d_{0}}{d}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}}$（因此海啸波在接近海滩时会增大振幅并变窄）。
